names.note: Name page 13750 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Петр (Троицкий), диакон, сщмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «Петра диакона». THE SURNAME IS WHAT KEEPS THIS FORM OUT OF A FOLD: eleven folders in this corpus share a bare «Петр», and `fk.mjs` on «Петр (Троицкий)» returns NONE — the ten Troitsky folders the corpus keeps carry other forenames.

death.note: The day line closes «(1938)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 15 июля ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Петра диакона (1938).»

attestations.note: The day's fifth and last entry, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page behind it. «диакон» on the name page and «диакона» on the line are the `deacon` in `types`; NO `office` was written, the word being absent from the four locale packs, which is the reading the twentieth-century deacons of the Julian 10 July were given. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar's twentieth-century «сщмч.» entries, and THE 26 ЯНВАРЯ SYNAXIS PAGE WAS NOT OPENED. No folder held him. The day page prints no hymn under his name.
